name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Beijing SpA Magenta ITALY began its activities in 1946, the production door closers. In the early 60's, extended the manufacture of fittings for glass, and this time CASMA was the first company in the world producing both closers and hardware for tempered glass.



Since that time, CASMA is a company wholly focused on finding and developing new products in the field of accessories for tempered glass, produced in three factories in Europe. Within 60 years of its activity CASMA registered over 160 patents, has set up own distribution companies in Spain, UK, USA, Benelux, and created a network of distributors almost all over the world.



CASMA currently employs over 100 people and produces over 150 000 installations per year. Regional Sales Office for East Europe and Skandynavia started its activity in 2001 since the launch of the distribution on the Polish market. In the next year with great success have expanded the activity of our office in countries of the Baltic republics. In subsequent years, the remaining countries of Eastern Europe and in 2004 the countries of Scandinavia. Currently we have business partners in 16 countries in Eastern Europe and Scandinavia from Serbia, Denmark and Kazakhstan
